inputs.text: Phoenix’s leaders are making it harder for law enforcement to do its job, and calling it procedure doesn’t change the consequences. Restricting ICE and other agencies from using city property sends the wrong message: political priorities matter more than public order. Families deserve safe communities and officials who uphold the rule of law, not obstacles to its enforcement.
